title: Unlocking the potential of metastable-phase catalysts: advantages, stabilization, and applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,7706-7739
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00775A, Review Article
Yutong Du, Chendi Zhao, Shuangxing Li, Tangzixuan Dai, Xudong Yang, Yuanle Zhu, Qi Shao
Metastable-phase materials are promising candidates for catalytic field. This review focuses on advantages, challenges, stability enhancement strategies, main categories, formation mechanism and diverse applications of metastable-phase catalysts.
